svg.aria-label: it passes, and the ON-TIME pane is published
svg.text: When — three triggers on one window, and the lateness threshold
4 early · on-time 15 at 12:04:06 · late 19 at 12:04:40 · needs allowed >= 81s
2 // Two of an event's five fields are CLOCKS, which ch01 established:
3 // et = event time, when it happened · pt = processing time, when we saw it
4 // v = the value being summed · key = which stream it belongs to
5 type Event { id, key, et, pt, v }
6 // primitive: EVENTS — the book's 9 events, in PROCESSING order (tools/stream_seed.js).
7 // EVENTS[7] = (id 7, key "b", et 50, pt 280, v 4) <- the late one
8 // primitive: NONE — no value. Distinct from a value of 0.
9 // primitive: WIN — the fixed window width, in seconds of event time. WIN = 120
10 // primitive: LAG — the watermark's assumed worst-case skew. LAG = 60
11 // primitive: W0 — the window this chapter specifies. W0 = 0 ([12:00, 12:02))
12 // primitive: winOf(et) — the START of the WIN-second event-time window holding et.
14 // primitive: sum(ids) — total v over those event ids.
16 // primitive: append(xs, x) — xs with x added at the end. append([1], 2) = [1,2]
19 type State { ids, panes, open, onTime }
21 // primitive: PERIOD — the early trigger's firing interval. PERIOD = 60
22 // primitive: ALLOWED — allowed lateness, in seconds of event time. ALLOWED = 81
23 // primitive: watermarkAfter(i) — the completeness claim after event i: the
24 // highest event time seen through i, minus LAG.
27 // function: onTimeDue(i) — has the watermark passed the window end yet?
34 // function: stillOpen(i) — is the window's STATE still held? This is the only
35 // thing that decides whether a straggler can change the answer.
42 // function: early(st, t) — the clock trigger: a speculative pane at time t, until
43 // the on-time pane has gone out.
44 // early(st, 60) appends an EARLY pane of 8
46 if (st.onTime == false) { st.panes = append(st.panes, Pane(t, sum(st.ids), "EARLY")) }
50 // function: feed(st, e, i) — one arriving event, through the on-time and late triggers.
51 // Every event is fed, in or out of the window, because any event can move the watermark.
52 // feed(st, EVENTS[4], 4) appends an ON-TIME pane of 15
53 // feed(st, EVENTS[7], 7) appends a LATE pane of 19
56 if (st.open == false) { return st } // state gone: too late
63 if (st.onTime && winOf(e.et) == W0) { st.panes = append(st.panes, Pane(e.pt, sum(st.ids), "LATE")) }
67 // function: main() — THE CALLER: replay the stream, with the clock firing between arrivals.
Step 3/0 — it passes, and the ON-TIME pane is published
Event id 4 is not in the window (`winOf(245)` = 240), but it still moves the watermark: `watermarkAfter(4)` jumped to 185, so the trigger fires and publishes `sum([0, 1, 2])` =
**15**. The window's true total is 19. The pane and the error are produced by the same line, because the watermark's claim was wrong.
